card.name: Small linking words in drug-label clauses
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as 'with' or 'are' that follow a noun and introduce a qualifying phrase in drug-label text, and a few section-number digits inside parentheses.

modes.label: 'with' after a noun
modes.description: The word 'with' follows a patient group or drug class and introduces a qualifier such as a narrow therapeutic index or expertise.
